description: This file defines a LoggingCallbackManager class responsible for managing callbacks in the litellm framework. It includes methods for adding, removing, and categorizing callbacks, as well as handling external callback configurations and caches.

classes.name: LoggingCallbackManager
classes.description: A class for managing various callbacks in the litellm framework, including adding, removing, categorizing, and caching callbacks, as well as handling special callback configurations via settings.

methods.name: add_litellm_input_callback(self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, str])
methods.description: Adds an input callback to litellm.input_callback.

methods.name: add_litellm_service_callback( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, str, Callable] )
methods.description: Adds a service callback to litellm.service_callback.

methods.name: add_litellm_callback(self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, str, Callable])
methods.description: Adds a general callback to litellm.callbacks.

methods.name: add_litellm_success_callback( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, str, Callable] )
methods.description: Adds a success callback to litellm.success_callback.

methods.name: add_litellm_failure_callback( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, str, Callable] )
methods.description: Adds a failure callback to litellm.failure_callback.

methods.name: add_litellm_async_success_callback( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str] )
methods.description: Adds an asynchronous success callback.

methods.name: add_litellm_async_failure_callback( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str] )
methods.description: Adds an asynchronous failure callback.

methods.name: remove_callback_from_list_by_object( self, callback_list, obj, require_self=True )
methods.description: Removes callbacks associated with a specific object, based on whether they are methods of that object or equal to it.

methods.name: _add_string_callback_to_list( self, callback: str, parent_list: List[Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str]] )
methods.description: Adds a string callback to a list if not already present.

methods.name: bool _check_callback_list_size( self, parent_list: List[Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str]] )
methods.description: Checks whether adding a callback would exceed the MAX_CALLBACKS limit.

methods.name: Union[GenericAPILogger,str] _add_custom_callback_generic_api_str( callback: str, )
methods.description: Handles callback strings by loading configuration, caching, and returning GenericAPILogger instances if applicable.

methods.name: _safe_add_callback_to_list( self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str], parent_list: List[Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str]], )
methods.description: Safely adds a callback to a parent list, resolving strings to logger instances when necessary and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _add_callback_function_to_list( self, callback: Callable, parent_list: List[Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str]] )
methods.description: Adds a callback function to a list if not already present.

methods.name: _add_custom_logger_to_list( self, custom_logger: CustomLogger, parent_list: List[Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str]], )
methods.description: Adds a custom logger to a list, avoiding duplicates based on unique key.

methods.name: _get_custom_logger_key(self, custom_logger: CustomLogger)
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a custom logger based on its class and fundamental attributes.

methods.name: _reset_all_callbacks(self)
methods.description: Resets all callback lists to empty.

methods.name: List[Union[CustomLogger,Callable,str]] _get_all_callbacks(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all callbacks from different litellm callback lists.

methods.name: Set[AdditionalLoggingUtils] get_active_additional_logging_utils_from_custom_logger( self, )
methods.description: Returns active callbacks that are instances of AdditionalLoggingUtils.

methods.name: List[CustomLogger] get_custom_loggers_for_type( self, callback_type: Type[CustomLogger] )
methods.description: Returns all custom loggers of a specific type.

methods.name: bool callback_is_active(self, callback_type: Type[CustomLogger])
methods.description: Checks if any active callback is of a certain custom logger type.

methods.name: CallbacksByType get_callbacks_by_type(self)
methods.description: Categorizes active callbacks into success, failure, and success_and_failure groups.

methods.name: str _get_callback_string(self, callback: Union[CustomLogger, Callable, str])
methods.description: Converts a callback (string, function, or custom logger) into its string representation.

methods.name: Optional[CustomLogger] get_active_custom_logger_for_callback_name( self, callback_name: _custom_logger_compatible_callbacks_literal, )
methods.description: Retrieves the active custom logger associated with a callback name, raises error if none found.
